system.description: Instead of a normal melee attack at the end of a Charge, you can spend a Force Point to make a Whirlwind Attack at the end of a Charge, provided you are not wielding any weapons (other than Combat Gloves, a Stunning Gauntlet, or Shockboxing Gloves).
